description: Upload a soundboard sound from an audio URL: mp3 or ogg, up to 512 KB and 5.2 seconds. Servers start with eight sound slots; boosts add more.

emoji.description: An emoji to show with the sound.

guild.description: Guild (server) name or ID. Omit to use the default guild.

sound_file.description: A sound file in the local files folder (DISCORD_MCP_FILES_DIR), by name, instead of a link. Only that folder is read, and only when it is set.

sound_url.description: Public http or https link to the sound file itself.

name: create_soundboard_sound
title: Create soundboard sound
